home.heroText: Welcome to my world of handmade ceramics, where passion meets creative chaos. From my cozy kitchen studio in Warsaw, I hand-sculpt and hand-paint unique, one-of-a-kind pieces.
home.quote: The one who works with his hands, it's a worker. The one who works with his hands and his head, it's an artisan. The one who works with his hands and his head and his heart, it's an artist.
home.aboutText: Every piece is made by hand, with care and attention to every detail. Functional ceramics that combine simplicity of form with the warmth of the material.

cookies.bannerText: We only store what the store needs to work — your cart, login and payment. We use no analytics or marketing trackers. You can decide whether to allow the optional categories.
cookies.settingsIntro: Decide what we may store on your device. You can change this at any time — it never affects your ability to shop.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: Keeping you logged in, holding your cart, running checkout and payment, and remembering preferences you set yourself (currency, wishlist). The store cannot work without these, so they need no consent (Art. 399(3) of the Polish Electronic Communications Law).

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Visit statistics — which pages are viewed and for how long. They help improve the store. We currently use no analytics tool; if that changes, it will only load after you agree.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.description: Tailoring ads and measuring how they perform, e.g. on social media. We currently use no marketing tool; if that changes, it will only load after you agree.

cookies.intro: This page explains what we store on your device, why, and for how long. It covers both classic cookies and browser storage (localStorage, sessionStorage).
cookies.legalBasis: The legal basis is Art. 399 of the Polish Electronic Communications Law of 12 July 2024 and the GDPR. Storage strictly needed for a service you asked for — holding your cart, processing your payment — requires no consent. Everything else is stored only after you agree, and withdrawing that agreement is as easy as giving it.
cookies.noTrackingNote: As of today the store loads no analytics or advertising scripts, which is why no rows appear in those categories. Any such tool added in future will be listed here and will load only after you agree.
cookies.browserNote: Regardless of the panel above, you can manage cookies in your browser settings — including blocking them entirely or deleting stored ones. Blocking necessary cookies may make it impossible to place an order.
